Netscape: here's my encryption certificate for S/MIME testing
purposes.  Beware that this is an Entrust certificate rather than
Verisign.  Among other things, this means that I have a separate
key pair for signing and encryption, so you'll have to use this
one to encrypt for me and use the certif included with signed
messages (rather than this one) to verify signatures.

Eric
---------------------
subject: My encryption certificate for S/MIME testing
